workflows.name: Add the level 2 people from the routing rule
workflows.description: Adds the level 2 people to the ticket, when the routing rule named some.

workflows.name: Send the ticket to whoever handles it (replaced)
workflows.description: Gives a new ticket to the person the routing rules name, records it, and adds level 2 to the ticket. Needs Find who handles it first.

workflows.name: Give the ticket to someone (replaced)
workflows.description: Hands the ticket to one person and records it on the timeline. Needs the ticket found first.

assignee_name.description: Who the ticket goes to. If the person says me or myself, use their own name.

workflows.name: Check the person may act on the ticket
workflows.description: Stops unless the person may act on the ticket that was found. Needs the ticket found first.

case_number.description: The ticket number, for example CS-26-08-00017. Any format is accepted.

workflows.name: Clear the closing time
workflows.description: When the new status is not closed, clears the closing time. Needs the ticket found first.

workflows.name: Close a ticket (replaced)
workflows.description: Closes the ticket with a closing note and records it. Needs the ticket found first.

note.description: The closing note. Compulsory, so everyone knows what was done.

workflows.name: Add a note to a ticket
workflows.description: Puts a note on the ticket's timeline. Needs the ticket found first.

workflows.name: Create a ticket (replaced)
workflows.description: Saves a new ticket with its number, category and due time (the time the category allows, else from the priority).

title.description: A short title for the problem.

category_id.description: The category's id, if one was chosen.

description.description: What happened, in the person's words.

workflows.name: Work out the due time again for the new priority
workflows.description: Works out the due time again, counting from when the ticket was raised. Needs the ticket found and the response time looked up first.

workflows.name: Work out the due time from the priority
workflows.description: Sets the due time of a new ticket from the response time of its priority. Needs the response time looked up first.

title.description: A short title for the problem.

category_id.description: The category's id, if one was chosen.

description.description: What happened, in the person's words.

workflows.name: Work out the due time from the routing rule
workflows.description: When the routing rule gave a time, uses it instead of the one from the priority.

title.description: A short title for the problem.

category_id.description: The category's id, if one was chosen.

description.description: What happened, in the person's words.

workflows.name: Find a ticket (replaced)
workflows.description: Finds the ticket from its number (any format) and stops unless the person may act on it.

case_number.description: The ticket number, for example CS-26-08-00017. Any format is accepted.

workflows.name: Find a ticket by its number
workflows.description: Finds the ticket from its number (any format) and keeps it for the steps after. Stops if there is no such ticket.

case_number.description: The ticket number, for example CS-26-08-00017. Any format is accepted.

workflows.name: Find the person to give the ticket to
workflows.description: Finds the person by name, among the people who are active.

assignee_name.description: Who the ticket goes to. If the person says me or myself, use their own name.

workflows.name: Give the new ticket to the person the routing rule names
workflows.description: Gives a new ticket to the person the routing rules name, when they named one. Needs the ticket saved and the routing rule found first.

workflows.name: Look up the response time of the priority
workflows.description: Finds how long the priority gets, from the response-time table, for the steps after.

title.description: A short title for the problem.

category_id.description: The category's id, if one was chosen.

description.description: What happened, in the person's words.

workflows.name: Record the assignment
workflows.description: Writes the hand-over on the ticket timeline. Needs the ticket and the person found first.

assignee_name.description: Who the ticket goes to. If the person says me or myself, use their own name.

workflows.name: Record the closing and its note
workflows.description: Writes the closing, with its note, on the ticket timeline. Needs the ticket found first.

note.description: The closing note. Compulsory, so everyone knows what was done.

workflows.name: Record the priority change
workflows.description: Writes the new priority on the ticket timeline. Needs the ticket found first.

workflows.name: Record that the ticket was reported
workflows.description: Writes "reported" on the ticket timeline. Needs the ticket saved first.

title.description: A short title for the problem.

category_id.description: The category's id, if one was chosen.

description.description: What happened, in the person's words.

workflows.name: Record the routing assignment
workflows.description: Writes on the ticket timeline that the routing rule gave the ticket to that person. Runs only when the rule named one.

workflows.name: Record the status change
workflows.description: Writes the status change on the ticket timeline. Needs the ticket found first.

workflows.name: Mark the ticket closed
workflows.description: Sets the ticket to closed and notes the time. Needs the ticket found first.

note.description: The closing note. Compulsory, so everyone knows what was done.

workflows.name: Give the ticket to that person
workflows.description: Hands the ticket to the person that was found. Needs the ticket and the person found first.

assignee_name.description: Who the ticket goes to. If the person says me or myself, use their own name.

workflows.name: Save the new ticket
workflows.description: Saves a new ticket with its number, title, place, priority and due time.

title.description: A short title for the problem.

category_id.description: The category's id, if one was chosen.

description.description: What happened, in the person's words.

workflows.name: Save the new priority and due time
workflows.description: Changes the priority and the due time of the ticket. Needs the ticket found first.

workflows.name: Save the new status
workflows.description: Moves the ticket to another status. Needs the ticket found first.

workflows.name: Put the new ticket in its category
workflows.description: Puts the ticket in the category that was found, when there is one. Needs the ticket saved first.

title.description: A short title for the problem.

category_id.description: The category's id, if one was chosen.

description.description: What happened, in the person's words.

workflows.name: Change a ticket's priority (replaced)
workflows.description: Changes the priority and works out the due time again from when the ticket was raised.

workflows.name: Change a ticket's status (replaced)
workflows.description: Moves the ticket to another status and records it. Needs the ticket found first.

workflows.name: Note the time the ticket was closed
workflows.description: When the new status is closed, writes the closing time. Needs the ticket found first.

workflows.name: Tell the person who now has the ticket (old, unused)
workflows.description: Sends the new handler a message about the ticket. Needs the ticket found and the person chosen first.

workflows.name: Tell everyone on the ticket, without buttons
workflows.description: Messages everyone on the ticket except the person doing this, once each, without buttons. Runs unless tell_buttons is yes. The caller gives the wording.

tell_buttons.description: Say yes to put Add update, Pass on and Close buttons under the message.

tell_message.description: The message. Use {case_case_number}, {case_title}, {actor_name} or a field name in braces.

tell_message_assignee.description: A different message for the person who now has the ticket. Leave out to send everyone the same.

workflows.name: Tell everyone on the ticket, with buttons
workflows.description: Messages everyone on the ticket except the person doing this, once each, with Add update, Pass on and Close buttons. Runs only when tell_buttons is yes. The caller gives the wording.

tell_buttons.description: Say yes to put Add update, Pass on and Close buttons under the message.

tell_message.description: The message. Use {case_case_number}, {case_title}, {actor_name} or a field name in braces.

tell_message_assignee.description: A different message for the person who now has the ticket. Leave out to send everyone the same.

workflows.name: Tell the person who has the ticket (old, unused)
workflows.description: Sends the person the ticket is with now a message, unless they are the one acting. Give it tell_prefix and tell_text.

tell_text.description: The rest of the message, for example a closing note.

tell_prefix.description: The words after the ticket number and title, for example 'was closed.'

workflows.name: Tell everyone on the ticket (replaced)
workflows.description: Messages everyone on the ticket except the person doing this, once each. The caller gives the wording.

tell_buttons.description: Say yes to put Add update, Pass on and Close buttons under the message.

tell_message.description: The message. Use {case_case_number}, {case_title}, {actor_name} or a field name in braces.

tell_message_assignee.description: A different message for the person who now has the ticket. Leave out to send everyone the same.

workflows.name: Tell the person who raised the ticket (old, unused)
workflows.description: Sends the person who raised the ticket a message, unless they are the one acting. Give it tell_prefix and tell_text, for example 'is now with' and a name.

tell_text.description: The rest of the message, for example a person's name or a closing note.

tell_prefix.description: The words after the ticket number and title, for example 'is now with'.

workflows.name: File a complaint
workflows.description: Files a new complaint. It is put in a category, sent to whoever the routing rules name, and everyone on the case is told.

title.label: Problem
title.question: What is the problem? Send a short title, for example “Lift stuck on 5th floor”.
title.description: Short summary of the complaint, e.g. "Water leakage in Wing 2 basement"

location.label: Where
location.question: Where is it? Wing, flat or common area.
location.description: Wing / flat / common area where the issue is

priority.label: Priority
priority.question: How urgent is it?
priority.description: One of urgent, high, medium, low. ONLY set this if the user explicitly states an urgency level or uses clearly urgent language (for example emergency, immediately dangerous, fire). Never infer priority from the topic of the complaint alone. If not stated, leave it unset and ask the user, or default to medium only after telling them you are defaulting it.

description.label: Details
description.description: Optional longer explanation of the issue

workflows.name: My Open Tickets
